_comment: Copy to columnmap.json (auto-loaded from the base dir) or pass with --column-map. Each field maps to a list of header-label aliases; a column matches if its header text CONTAINS any alias (case-insensitive), most-specific alias first. Delete fields you don't need to override — omitted fields keep the built-in defaults. Run `python -m scripts.title_agent map` to see what resolves before running.
